create.name: Bill Philipps
create.bio:
Bill Philipps is a psychic medium and spiritual teacher who works from an office in downtown Salem, Oregon, and online. He describes seeing spirits as a small child, an ability that faded as he grew up, until the death of his mother, after which he experienced her presence beside him one night. A few years later, aged eighteen, he walked into a psychic development class that turned out to be on mediumship, and the teachers there encouraged him to develop what they saw in him. Much of his work since has been with people who are grieving, passing on evidential details and messages from loved ones who have died, while reminding clients that free will always shapes what lies ahead.

Bill gives private readings in person and by video or telephone, holds audience readings at spiritual centres across the United States and leads weekend workshops on intuition and psychic development, including programmes at Kripalu. He has written three books with New World Library: Expect the Unexpected, on the comfort spirit communication can bring; Signs from the Other Side, on noticing the ways the departed make contact; and Soul Searching, a practice guide to quietening the ego and trusting inner wisdom. He has also recorded a series of guided angel meditations.

books.title: Expect the Unexpected: Bringing Peace, Healing, and Hope from the Other Side
books.author: Bill Philipps
books.description: Bill's first book, telling how his gift as a medium unfolded and sharing stories from readings in which messages from the departed brought comfort to those left behind.

books.title: Signs from the Other Side: Opening to the Spirit World
books.author: Bill Philipps
books.description: A guide to the ways loved ones in spirit are said to reach out, from dreams to small coincidences, and how readers can learn to notice and trust these signs themselves.

books.title: Soul Searching: Tune In to Spirit and Awaken Your Inner Wisdom
books.author: Bill Philipps
books.description: A practical workbook for quietening the fearful voice of the ego, reconnecting with your inner light and living with more clarity and purpose.

courses.title: Private Reading with Bill Philipps
courses.description: A one-to-one psychic and mediumship reading at Bill's Salem office or by Zoom or telephone, in 60- or 90-minute lengths, with guests and small private groups also possible. The waiting list is long.

courses.title: Expect the Unexpected Audience Reading, Portland, OR
courses.description: An afternoon gallery reading at Unity Spiritual Center of Portland in which Bill passes on messages from spirit to members of the audience.

courses.title: Journey to Your Spirit Guide: Guided Meditation by Bill Philipps
courses.description: One of Bill's downloadable guided meditations, leading the listener to meet and listen to a spirit guide. His shop also offers angel meditations and journeys to loved ones.

free_resources.title: The Angelic Light Series: Meditation Previews
free_resources.description: Free sample clips from Bill's guided meditations with the archangels Jophiel, Chamuel, Gabriel and Michael, to try before choosing a full track.
